attempts.text:
**The window starts in the `gcv` system.** Columns 0 to 2, `gcvT`, `gcvH` and `gcvP`, [[glycine cleavage]], are spine columns carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0%. The model names them in 97 to 100% of calls and hesitates no more than 0.06 bits.

**A variable column follows at 3**, then a long spine, columns 4 to 16, `bglA` to `idi`, carried by 93 to 95% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 96%. The model names 91 to 99% there, hesitating most at `idi`, 0.43 bits. Column 17 is variable and lies in a region of plasticity in 97% of calls.

**Columns 20 to 37 are variable**, carried by 82 to 86% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 88 to 95% of calls: `ygfT` to `ygeV`, [[xanthine and selenium metabolism]]. The model names 73 to 98% there. Then `xdhC`, `xdhB` and `xdhA` lead into the window's most hesitant columns: `actS` at 41, 1.25 bits, `yqeF` at 42, 2.00 bits, and `kduI` at 43, 1.63 bits, in a region of plasticity in 72 to 76% of calls.

**The last stretch, columns 44 to 79, is fork and variable columns**, in a region of plasticity in 17 to 69% of calls, named in 81 to 95%. Its branches carry their own families: `eivA` to `eivJ2` through columns 46 to 49, [[type III secretion]], `ygeI` to `ygeG` through 55 to 57, and `amiC` to a glucose PTS transporter subunit through 70 to 72. The window ends at `csdA`, carried by 23% of chromosomes.

**Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside**, 0.69 against 0.16 bits, and names fewer genes, 88% against 96%. Across the window it names 92% of genes, 0.43 bits on average.

label: gcvT
facts:
WINDOW: the gcvT window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor gcvT, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 830 to 909 from dnaA. Read in 540 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying gcvT once); 43,200 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.43 bits on average (perplexity 1.6 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 22,896 calls, named 98%, 0.15 bits; shell 19,688 calls, named 87%, 0.66 bits; cloud 616 calls, named 16%, 3.90 bits. Outside an RGP 20,967 calls, named 96%, 0.16 bits; inside an RGP 22,233 calls, named 88%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 21 spine, 25 fork, 34 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.16 bits) and names fewer genes (88% against 96%); 22,233 of the 43,200 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 42 (yqeF) 2.00 bits, RGP 74%; column 43 (kduI) 1.63 bits, RGP 72%; column 41 (actS) 1.25 bits, RGP 76%. The 44 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 90%, 0.58 bits on average; the other 36 columns: named 94%, 0.26 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 17 (variable), RGP 97%; the least: columns 0-2 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: gcvT "glycine cleavage T C-terminal barre…", gcvH, gcvP. named 97-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 2 (gcvP), named 97%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.06 bits (column 2 (gcvP)).
2. column 3 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 41%; 0.75 bits.
   3: ygfF S 53% "SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidore…"
3. columns 4-16 (13 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 0.2-96%. Genes: bglA, yqfB "N(4)-acetylcytidine aminohydrolase", trhA, ygfZ "tRNA-modifying protein YgfZ", sdhE, ygfX "protein YgfX", fldB, xerD, dsbC, recJ, prfB, lysS, idi. named 91-99% (mean 98%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 16 (idi), named 91%, 0.43 bits.
4. column 17 variable: RGP 97%. named 95%; 0.46 bits.
   17: "hypothetical protein" S 84%
5. columns 18-19 (2 columns) spine: share 90-93%, 1 P, 1 S, RGP 94-95%. Genes: yqfG "protein YqfG", uacT. named 76-81% (mean 79%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 19 (uacT), named 76%, 0.82 bits.
6. columns 20-37 (18 columns) variable: RGP 88-95%. named 73-98% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 24, named 73%; most hesitant at column 20, 0.73 bits.
   columns 20-37, share 82-86%, 17 S, 1 P: ygfT "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…" 86%, ygfS "4Fe-4S binding protein" 85%, ghxQ 86%, guaD 86%, xanQ 85%, xdhD 85%, ygfM 86%, ssnA 86%, ygfK "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase" 85%, mocA 86%, yqeC "selenium cofactor biosynthesis prot…" 85%, yqeB "XdhC family protein" 85%, arcC 85%, hyuA 85%, ygeY 85%, dpaL 85%, ygeW "knotted carbamoyltransferase YgeW" 85%, ygeV "sigma-54-dependent Fis family trans…" 82%
7. column 38 spine: share 90%, all S, RGP 88%. Genes: xdhC "xanthine dehydrogenase iron sulfur-…". named 96%; 0.29 bits.
8. columns 39-40 (2 columns) variable: RGP 76-87%. named 94-95% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 40, named 94%, 0.52 bits.
   39: xdhB S 89%
   40: xdhA S 88%
9. column 41 spine: share 92%, all P, RGP 76%. Genes: actS. named 82%; 1.25 bits.
10. column 42 fork: RGP 74%. named 74%; 2.00 bits.
   42: yqeF P 89% "acetyl-CoA C-acetyltransferase"; also ygeQ S 57%, "IS1-like element transposase" S 38%, "GhoT/OrtT family toxin" S 22%
11. column 43 spine: share 90%, all P, RGP 72%. Genes: kduI "5-dehydro-4-deoxy-D-glucuronate iso…". named 72%; 1.63 bits.
12. columns 44-79 (36 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 17-69%. named 81-95% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 44, named 81%, 1.25 bits.
